frontmatter.title: Automating Algorithm Discovery: A Case Study in Congestion Control Optimization
frontmatter.author: Shulu Li, Audrey Cheng, Ion Stoica, ADRS Team
frontmatter.excerpt: In this blog post, we apply ADRS frameworks to improve state-of-the-art congestion control algorithms in datacenter networking. In just 1.5 hours of autonomous evolution, the AI evolved the SOTA baseline from PowerTCP into a more responsive algorithm, reducing average queue length by 49% while maintaining high throughput.
